856-4247-5776-8347.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

2946-4871-5670-6559.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
2946-4871-5670-6559.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-5670-6559.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Venerated Stormsinger and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

628-6495-7214.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Glen Elendra Guardian.
When Glen Elendra Guardian dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
628-6495-7214.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1895-2781-6867-6967.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

549-4186-6824-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-4186-6824-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

957-4428-7722.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one
Move to your first extra turn.
Blink Thor using Thassa.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Stretch from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your second extra turn.
Cast Time Stretch from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

3497-4050-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
3497-4050-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying at most {1} due to Ezzaroot Channeler. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

3043-7282-7340.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with defender.
3043-7282-7340.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Axebane Guardian.
Repeat.

5470-7220.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a token copy of Glamermite.
5470-7220.description:
Create a token copy of Glamermite.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of the Glamermite copy.
When the Glamermite token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Ghired.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

81-625-1978.description:
Cause Kami of Whispered Hopes to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat from step 2.

478-5116-6871.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus and Candelabra of Tawnos as they are lands due to Toph.
Repeat.

339-677-997-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
339-677-997-4068.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1496-2034-4593-6705.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
1496-2034-4593-6705.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

586-2350-5258-5618-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4484-4871-5231-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
4484-4871-5231-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath, adding {R}{R}.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
4484-4871-5231-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

719-783-1399-1606.description:
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {C}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Jungle Basin.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

1563-2457-2557-5223.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

3918-3941-4038.description:
Activate Trazyn using Coveted Jewel's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trazyn.
Repeat.

1753-2525-3358.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

997-1003-1329-2178.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
997-1003-1329-2178.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1799-2048-5231-5359.description:
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod four times by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk and the Gnomes, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

372-864-3647.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Displace exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-864-3647.description:
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Eternal Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Eternal Witness trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Displace.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Eternal Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

4659-5365-5395.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue.
4659-5365-5395.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' third ability and Piper Wright's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Piper Wright trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Repeat.
4659-5365-5395.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead sacrifice the Clues to their own abilities

requires.n: Creature with MV>=4 that has a generic mana cost

866-2292-5220--66.notablePrerequisites: You have cast your commander from the command zone enough times to cast the creature with MV>=4  for its blitz cost by paying {0}.
866-2292-5220--66.description:
Cast the creature with MV>=4 for its blitz cost by paying {0}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting it from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the creature's trigger, causing you to draw it from the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

618-1228-4613.notablePrerequisites: Goblin Sharpshooter has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
618-1228-4613.description:
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of Goblin Sharpshooter with haste.
Activate the token Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
The token Goblin Sharpshooter dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering the nontoken Goblin Sharpshooter, untapping the nontoken Goblin Sharpshooter.
Repeat.

2511-4812-5145.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Animate Dead enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Animate Dead to it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2104-2223-2707.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Anurid Scavenger triggers, causing you to put Temporal Manipulation on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your draw step, drawing Temporal Manipulation from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat.

632-1978-3621-4659.notablePrerequisites: Scarecrone does not have summoning sickness.
632-1978-3621-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Activate Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Scarecrone.
Repeat.

628-1365-4853-5256.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Dross Scorpion persist until end of turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dross Scorpion.
Dross Scorpion dies, triggering its ability, its undying ability and its persist ability.
Resolve the first Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dross Scorpion.
Dross Scorpion dies, triggering its ability and its undying ability.
Resolve the first Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the second Dross Scorpion trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dross Scorpion.
Dross Scorpion dies, triggering its ability and its persist ability.
Repeat from step 4.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities, causing any number of players to mill infinite cards.

543-3858.notablePrerequisites: Colossus of Akros is not monstrous.
543-3858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, activate Colossus of Akros by paying {10}, putting ten +1/+1 counters on it and causing it to become monstrous.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life, and win the game.

678-4050-5004.notablePrerequisites: You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.
678-4050-5004.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cathodion, adding one mana of any color.
Cathodion dies, triggering itself and Enduring Renewal.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, causing you to return Cathodion from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Cathodion by paying {3}.
Repeat.
